In the video you see blaaacky spazzing out when he holds down crouch while jumping, this can only be done by jumpscript.
Scrollwheel don't work ((try if you don't belive)(also try jumpscript if you still don't belive)) this is a basic script that spamms spacebar to hit the jump when you hit the ground. With right timing you can go realy fast with it aswell. Also, occasionaly when you hit ctrl while using this your ctrl might get stuck. (wich you also see in video) I've been admin on another csgo community for 3 years, that's why I know this.

but if you have a script you can easely get anywhere before everyone else.

Again, thank you for your help.
